Blue Sea signature maker (v4.7, wide 1:1, 600 × 480px, Open Sans)

Type one person's details, check the preview, then download their signature file. The desktop layout as one fixed 600px design with normal text sizes, about 480px tall with bigger resort logos. PCs show it full size; phones zoom the whole thing out evenly, like a photo. Nothing moves or wraps.

Phone, address and links are the same for everyone and already in the signature.

  1. Leave every field empty to download the editable template (placeholders), for people who will type their own details in Outlook.
  2. The file is named after the person. That name is what they will see in Outlook's signature list.
  3. Nothing typed here is saved or sent anywhere.
  4. iPhone Mail: tap Add to Mail app (iPhone), select it all, copy, paste into Settings → Apps → Mail → Signature, then shake (or swipe left with three fingers) and tap Undo to keep the styling. Same look as the Outlook version, but every line's colour and font is written three times, so iPhone Mail can't drop it (text no longer turns black/white in sent emails or in dark mode).
  5. Wide 1:1: phones zoom it out evenly (about 58% on a 375px phone), so the layout never changes and no app enlarges the text. Drag the preview box (or use the buttons) to check. Nothing in it can be removed by Outlook, so it looks the same from every sender.
Screen: 600 px wide · signature 0 px tall Full size (100%) Drag the handle on the right to change the screen width.
